estimates.assumptions: 1 lb dry penne rigate (standard 454 g package); values for uncooked pasta as used in recipe before boiling
1/4 cup olive oil (60 ml / ~55 g); all oil is used in the skillet sauce
3 cloves garlic (~9 g total, minced); modest weight for typical clove size
1 standard 400 g / 14 oz tin chopped tomatoes, drained weight ~240 g edible portion after accounting for juice
1/2 tsp red chilli flakes (~1 g); negligible contribution from small seasoning amount
1/2 tsp Italian seasoning (~1 g); negligible contribution from small seasoning amount
6 fresh basil leaves (~6 g total); modest weight for typical leaf size
sprinkling of Parmigiano-Reggiano (~20 g grated as typical modest garnish for the whole dish)
